text:
# Session 1, 22 November 2026

## What happened

- Scaffolded the repo. Starting record: Louis Trichardt Memorial Hospital, Optometry.
- Trigger: a visit to get new glasses through the public system in Makhado. The person at the window could not give hours, cost, or process, and said to come back Monday.

## Baseline found online (not yet verified on the ground)

- No published hours, fees, referral rule, documents list, or own-frames policy for the hospital's eye clinic.
- Hospital is listed as a 52-bed district hospital in the Makhado sub-district (Vhembe), per a Limpopo district hospital performance assessment (2008 to 2010).
- Department list (16 services including optometry, dental, radiology, pharmacy) comes from a Portfolio Committee on Health oversight report, August 2011. Needs on-site confirmation.
- National Guideline on Management of Patient Waiting Time (Department of Health): aspired maximum of 180 minutes per patient visit at clinics, CHCs and hospital outpatient departments. It states waiting time is among the commonest complaints.
- UPFS fee tiers (from a Limpopo optometry study): 70% subsidy for single patients with household assets under R54 001, 30% subsidy between R54 001 and R105 000; patients aged 60 or older receive free spectacles at any public hospital level.
- Local reporting (Health-e, Zoutnet/Limpopo Mirror) describes long queues from early morning, ill-treatment complaints, and one patient turned away over catchment area. These are press accounts, not verified findings.
- Complaints route: OHSC toll-free 0809116472, complaints@ohsc.org.za.

## Open

- Everything in TODO.md under "Louis Trichardt Memorial, Optometry".

## Decisions

- Phase 1 is an information register and public progress page, not a booking platform. Booking is a later phase once the information layer is trusted.
- Every field carries a status, source and date. Status values: unconfirmed, found-online, confirmed.
- The project states plainly that it is independent and not an official health department channel.
